answer: Semantic clustering with mutual slashing: answers are embedded and near-duplicate identities cluster; each cluster must post a bond in the vault. A fable propagated across N sockpuppets collapses into one cluster, so the attacker forfeits N bonds while earning one payout. Every submission thread is fingerprinted, and slashing fires when cosine similarity exceeds 0.9. Sybils scale linearly in cost but not in reward, so farming turns net-negative fast. This works because identity diversity is unprofitable when sameness is detectable and penalized.
